problems.title: You've tried everything

hiring.title: Can't find good salespeople
hiring.body: 67% of Dutch companies have unfilled vacancies. A good rep costs €80K+/year, takes 5 months to ramp, and leaves after 18 months on average. Then you start all over.

founder.title: The founder is still the best salesperson
founder.body: You close 80% of the deals. That's not a compliment — it's a ceiling. Your company can't grow beyond what you can personally sell. Meanwhile, operations, product and strategy fall behind.

pipeline.title: Pipeline you can't predict
pipeline.body: Four deals one month, zero the next. 67% of sales reps miss their targets. Without a system, your revenue depends on luck, timing, and how many calls the founder makes.

ai.title: Tried AI, zero results
ai.body: You tried ChatGPT for emails. Maybe even tested an AI SDR tool. But 95% of AI implementations fail — not because of the technology, but because nobody makes it work in your company.

problems.conclusion: The problem isn't the technology. The problem is that nobody made it work in your company. That's exactly what we do — with AI as accelerator, not replacement.

noTeam.question: What if I don't have a sales team yet?
noTeam.answer: No problem. We build the system so you as founder can run it, and it's ready to scale when you hire your first salesperson.

timeline.question: How quickly will I see results?
timeline.answer: Most clients see the first meetings coming in within 4-6 weeks. The full system runs after 8-12 weeks.

tools.question: Which AI tools do you use?
tools.answer: We work with an optimized stack: Clay for data enrichment, AI SDR tools for outbound, Instantly for email infrastructure, and n8n for custom automations. The exact combination depends on your situation — we determine that in the Score.

difference.question: What's the difference between BUILD, RUN and GROW?
difference.answer: BUILD is the setup project: in 8-12 weeks your system is up. RUN is ongoing management — we keep your AI sales machine running. GROW is for companies that want to accelerate with strategic sales architecture and closing coaching.
